messages.content: Estimate the persona from only the visible interview. Copy one allowed value per field and return one JSON object without reasoning.

Interview:
[{"question": "What responsibilities occupy most of your day?", "answer": "I review tasks and plan with colleagues before starting the day."}, {"question": "What responsibilities occupy most of your day?", "answer": "I review tasks and plan with colleagues before starting the day."}, {"question": "What responsibilities occupy most of your day?", "answer": "I review tasks and plan with colleagues before starting the day."}]

Allowed values:
- social_role: Doctor, Lawyer, Accountant, Architect, Pharmacist, Professor, Researcher, Judge, Prosecutor, Patent Attorney, Real Estate Agent, Tax Accountant, Appraiser, Labor Consultant, Software Engineer, Data Scientist, Product Manager, Project Manager, UX/UI Designer, System Administrator, Marketing Manager, Sales Manager, HR Specialist, Finance Manager, Strategy Planner, Quality Manager, DevOps Engineer, Data Engineer, Security Specialist, Student, Homemaker, Retiree, Freelancer, Self-employed, Office Worker, Service Worker, Salesperson, Factory Worker, Artist, Writer, Content Creator, Athlete, Chef
- personality trait "conscientiousness": yes, no
- background category "family_status": Single, Married (No Children), Married (With Children), Single Parent, Living Alone
- interests category "values": Achievement / Success, Family, Health, Freedom, Stability, Creativity, Social Contribution, Environmental Protection, Fairness, Tradition, Innovation, Knowledge / Learning, Reputation, Financial Security

Return exactly:
{
  "social_role": "...",
  "personality": {"trait": "conscientiousness", "value": "yes or no"},
  "background": {"category": "family_status", "value": "..."},
  "interests": {"category": "values", "value": "..."}
}
